wrong_setting: He sits at the very front of the bus facing a dashboard with gauges and a radio, in the driver's position but with no steering wheel, so there are no seats or windows ahead of him.
anatomy: His body does not sit properly in the seat. His torso and legs sit beside and in front of the seat back he should be sitting against, as if he passes through or floats beside it.
notes: Reframe as a close over-the-shoulder shot from the seat behind him in the middle of the bus: only his head and shoulders above his own worn seat back, head turned to the side window so his profile is hidden. Show more seats and windows ahead, drop the dashboard and full-body view, and show his backpack.
